complexes.name: Rettifilo Chicane
complexes.note: Heavy braking off the main straight.
complexes.curb_note: Don't clip the exit curb hard.

complexes.name: Curva Grande
complexes.note: Flat-out or near it, just a lift.

complexes.name: Della Roggia Chicane
complexes.note: Second chicane. Compression on entry curb.
complexes.curb_note: Be ready for the compression on entry.

complexes.name: Lesmo 2
complexes.note: Tighter than it looks. Sets up the back straight.

complexes.name: Ascari Chicane
complexes.note: Left-right-left. Rhythm matters more than any single apex.
complexes.curb_note: Watch the exit curb, don't ride it hard.

complexes.name: Parabolica
complexes.note: Long and patient. Unwinds onto the front straight.

porsche-992-gt3r.note: Exceptional exit traction. Punishing if you brake while turning — brake in a straight line, let it settle, then turn.

ferrari-488-gt3.note: Doesn't rotate for you. Create rotation through braking and weight transfer; be early and progressive on throttle.
